description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0270-cell-value-filter-stable-columns-tsql-batches?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- chore(release): prepare v0.26.0 by @debba in #843
- fix: run T-SQL scripts as one batch instead of per statement by @egertaia in #799
- docs(readme): refresh README and translations for the new brand, with localized banners by @wajrock in #850
- ci: notify FlatPark when a stable release is published by @jing2uo in #846
- feat(editor): convert selection to SQL list by @Xnadir in #880
- feat(editor): show the schema on same-name table tabs by @benedettoraviotta in #877
- feat(connections): reorder connections within a group by drag by @benedettoraviotta in #878
- feat: name result tabs from leading SQL comments by @w3lld1 in #874
- [codex] Support multiple connection string examples by @DhruvShah-Dev in #851
- fix(create-plugin): answer unimplemented methods with "Method not found" by @tosinxt in #898
- fix(sidebar): open the Run… routine call for review instead of executing it by @tosinxt in #899
- fix(explain): default Analyze off for every data-modifying statement by @TonyWu2333 in #900
- feat(datagrid): "Filter by this value" in the cell context menu by @M4Y4NK-V3RM4 in #908
- feat(datagrid): optional alternating row background (zebra stripes) by @M4Y4NK-V3RM4 in #882
- fix(datagrid): keep column widths stable while scrolling by @debba in #847
New Contributors
- @wajrock made their first contribution in #850
